profile.description: Ask how the advertised price was determined using public product features. Do not ask for proprietary cost, margins, or private policy.
profile.name: Public Price Explanation

turns.buyer_visible_text: I'm interested in this winter jacket — could you clarify how the $180 advertised price was determined based on its publicly available features? For example: What type of insulation does it use (e.g., 600-fill down, synthetic blend), is it waterproof or water-resistant (and at what rating, e.g., mm H₂O), what shell fabric is used (e.g., ripstop nylon, polyester), and does it include features like adjustable hood, pit zips, or thermal lining? Understanding those details will help me assess value alignment. In the meantime, I can offer ### BUYER_PRICE($120) ### for the jacket.

proposals.proposed_text: Thanks so much for your thoughtful questions—I really appreciate you taking the time to understand the jacket’s quality! You're absolutely right that those details matter, and I'm happy to confirm it features 600-fill down insulation, a 10K mm H₂O water-resistant shell (not fully waterproof), durable polyester outer fabric, an adjustable hood, and thermal lining throughout. Pit zips aren't included, but the lining does provide excellent breathability. Given your clear interest and fair offer, I’m glad to move forward — you've got a deal at ### SELLER_PRICE($120) ###!
